facts.text: Starting in fall 2027, the University of Alaska Fairbanks eliminated out-of-state tuition through its Alaska Unlocked initiative, offering in-state tuition to all students.

sources.title: UAF Home | University of Alaska Fairbanks
sources.quote: Starting in fall 2027, we've unlocked Alaska by eliminating out-of-state tuition! At the University of Alaska Fairbanks you'll automatically receive the in-state tuition rate, regardless of where you're coming from.
